reviews.reason: Logic does not match the stated intent to “preserve missingness if either source is missing”: it sets NaN only when BOTH hh150 and hh160 are missing, but returns 0 when one is missing and the other is not yes. Also uses .astype('float') which can raise if the column contains non-numeric sentinels/strings; pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce') would be safer.

notes: Only identified issue is MOD-DWL-phone_any missingness handling vs comment/intent; others appear safe and consistent with stated produces/placement rules (t2#authored).
